Random Design

Carousels, decks, proposals, infographics, characters, stickers and memes that do not fit anywhere else.

What is this?

Not everything I make fits in one project. This page collects the rest: carousels, pitch decks, proposals, infographics, game characters, sticker packs and memes I made for class, competitions and for fun.

Each one taught me something different, from laying out data so people actually read it, to keeping a character recognisable across poses, to making a joke land in one frame.

My journey

Seven kinds of work, and what each one is about.

  1. 01

    Instagram carousels and posts

    Project showcase carousels for JamalPOS, Jamal Worshipper HRIS and EcoMetrik Daurlink, one feature per slide. Plus single posts for a hotel holiday offer, fashion collections, a vape pod, a cooperative app and a training bootcamp.

    • Carousel
    • UI showcase
    • Social media
  2. 02

    Pitch decks

    Presentation decks on game market revenue, Bitcoin, visual design principles, photography, EcoMetrik Daurlink and Echo of the Hollow. Each deck gets its own look to match its topic.

    • Presentation
    • Data
    • Slide design
  3. 03

    Proposals

    A project proposal for strengthening Bali weaving small businesses through branding and digital marketing, plus a data-based report on the game industry market.

    • Proposal
    • Report
    • Layout
  4. 04

    Infographics

    Posters that turn research into something you can scan: digital marketing for Indonesian small businesses, terrorist recidivism, and gaming balance.

    • Infographic
    • Data visualisation
    • Poster
  5. 05

    Echo characters

    Character art for Echo of the Hollow: the main character, a boss, an armoured knight, spear-and-shield mobs and a winged creature, all in the same cracked, shadowy style.

    • Character design
    • Game art
    • Illustration
  6. 06

    Sticker packs

    Sticker sheets for LLAMAAAJ, ALUR and Ibu Hilmi, each in a 3D low-poly and a 3D pixel-voxel edition, built from the brand colours and logos.

    • Sticker
    • 3D
    • Brand assets
  7. 07

    Memes

    Photo manipulations for fun: me inside Minecraft, a sneaker turned into a car and a Spider-Cat banner. Mostly an excuse to practise compositing.

    • Photo manipulation
    • Compositing
    • Fun
